title: Place a release within a milestone
statement: As a product manager, I can say which milestone a release belongs to, so a regular release cadence and a larger goal such as MVP stay related without being treated as the same thing.
overview: Trevor's direction: a milestone is like "MVP" and a release can just be something that happens every two weeks. They have different scopes and timelines. They are one to one in some shops, and in others releases happen every sprint, every Thursday or every day. This uses the existing shared milestone record and adds no version to it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A release can name one shared milestone, or none.
Any number of releases can name the same milestone, including exactly one.
A release's page and the Releases list show its milestone's name, linked.
The Roadmap and Features pages do not list releases.
`release list --milestone ID` lists the releases within that milestone.
Removing a milestone a release names is refused and names the release, as for any other dependency.
